content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "This is the real thing then. Not a market inefficiency you noticed in a deck, your grandfather's actual harvest, actual margin that never reached him.

Ten years of making companies efficient is not nothing to bring to that. You know where the waste sits and who usually eats the cost of it. That's a real edge over someone starting cold.

What part of the chain were you picturing, the farmer's side where he was, or further down where the margin disappears."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
